rows.en: The Puzzle Story Handout

rows.en: Instructions
rows.ne: निर्देशनहरू
rows.bt: Instructions

rows.en: • Change the place name in the first paragraph if you wish.
rows.ne: • चाहनुहुन्छ भने पहिलो अनुच्छेदमा रहेको ठाउँको नाम परिवर्तन गर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: • Change the place name in the first paragraph if you wish.

rows.en: • Print the story below (single-sided)
rows.ne: • तलको कथा कागजको एकातर्फ मात्र छाप्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: • Print the story below on only one side of the paper.

rows.en: • Cut so that each paragraph is on a separate piece of paper (cutting off the part numbers)
rows.ne: • प्रत्येक अनुच्छेद कागजको छुट्टै टुक्रामा पर्ने गरी काट्नुहोस् र भागका नम्बरहरू भएको अंश काटेर हटाउनुहोस्।
rows.bt: • Cut so that each paragraph is on a separate piece of paper, and cut off and remove the portion containing the part numbers.

rows.en: • Shuffle the pieces of paper and distribute them randomly among the groups. Note that there are multiple copies of Part 5 and Part 9 to represent duplication of services. You can distribute these across groups or shuffle randomly, with one group potentially receiving multiple copies of the same part.
rows.ne: • कागजका टुक्राहरू मिसाउनुहोस् र समूहहरूलाई अनियमित रूपमा बाँड्नुहोस्। सेवाहरू दोहोरिएको अवस्था देखाउन भाग 5 र भाग 9 का धेरै प्रतिहरू राखिएका छन् भन्ने ध्यान दिनुहोस्। यी प्रतिहरू विभिन्न समूहमा बाँड्न वा अनियमित रूपमा मिसाउन सक्नुहुन्छ; यसो गर्दा एउटै समूहले एउटै भागका धेरै प्रतिहरू पाउन सक्छ।
rows.bt: • Mix the pieces of paper and distribute them randomly to the groups. Note that multiple copies of Part 5 and Part 9 have been included to show a situation in which services are duplicated. You can distribute these copies among different groups or mix them randomly; doing so may result in the same group receiving multiple copies of the same part.

rows.en: Story: The Lost Rhythm of Valand
rows.ne: कथा: Valand को हराएको लय
rows.bt: Story: The Lost Rhythm of Valand

rows.en: Part 1:
rows.ne: भाग 1:
rows.bt: Part 1:

rows.en: In a remote region of Valand, there’s a village rich with a tradition of music and dance.
rows.ne: Valand को दुर्गम क्षेत्रमा सङ्गीत र नृत्यको समृद्ध परम्परा भएको एउटा गाउँ छ।
rows.bt: In a remote area of Valand, there is a village with a rich tradition of music and dance.

rows.en: This village is believed to hold the Lost Rhythm, a legendary melody that promises prosperity and favorable weather.
rows.ne: समृद्धि र अनुकूल मौसम ल्याउने वाचा गर्ने किंवदन्तीको धुन ‘हराएको लय’ यस गाउँमा रहेको विश्वास गरिन्छ।
rows.bt: The legendary tune ‘Lost Rhythm’, which promises to bring prosperity and favorable weather, is believed to be in this village.

rows.en: Part 2:
rows.ne: भाग 2:
rows.bt: Part 2:

rows.en: The magic of the Lost Rhythm is powerful.
rows.ne: हराएको लयको जादु शक्तिशाली छ।
rows.bt: The magic of the Lost Rhythm is powerful.

rows.en: When played correctly, it showers the village with abundant harvests and joy.
rows.ne: सही तरिकाले बजाउँदा यसले गाउँलाई प्रशस्त उब्जनी र आनन्दले भरिदिन्छ।
rows.bt: When played correctly, it fills the village with abundant harvests and joy.

rows.en: But a single wrong note can invoke droughts and strife.
rows.ne: तर एउटै गलत स्वरले पनि खडेरी र कलह निम्त्याउन सक्छ।
rows.bt: But even a single wrong note can bring drought and discord.

rows.en: Part 3:
rows.ne: भाग 3:
rows.bt: Part 3:

rows.en: Four village elders are the entrusted guardians of the Lost Rhythm.
rows.ne: गाउँका चार अग्रजलाई हराएको लयको संरक्षण गर्ने जिम्मा दिइएको छ।
rows.bt: Four elders of the village have been given the responsibility of protecting the Lost Rhythm.

rows.en: Each of them has a unique segment of this grand melody.
rows.ne: उनीहरू प्रत्येकसँग यस भव्य धुनको आआफ्नै विशिष्ट अंश छ।
rows.bt: Each of them has their own distinct portion of this magnificent tune.

rows.en: Part 4:
rows.ne: भाग 4:
rows.bt: Part 4:

rows.en: However, every elder believes their part to be the full melody.
rows.ne: तर हरेक अग्रजले आफूसँग भएको अंश नै पूरै धुन हो भन्ने विश्वास गर्छन्।
rows.bt: But each elder believes that the portion they have is the entire tune.

rows.en: Oblivious to the fragmented nature of their knowledge, they play their pieces with pride.
rows.ne: आफूसँग धुनको आंशिक ज्ञान मात्र छ भन्ने थाहा नभएकाले उनीहरू गर्वका साथ आआफ्ना अंश बजाउँछन्।
rows.bt: Not knowing that they have only partial knowledge of the tune, they proudly play their respective portions.

rows.en: Part 5:
rows.ne: भाग 5:
rows.bt: Part 5:

rows.en: But disaster strikes.
rows.ne: तर विपत्ति आइपर्छ।
rows.bt: But disaster strikes.

rows.en: The village undergoes a period of barren fields and dwindling water resources.
rows.ne: गाउँले खेतबारी बाँझो हुने र पानीका स्रोतहरू घट्दै जाने समय भोग्छ।
rows.bt: The village experiences a time when fields become barren and water sources dwindle.

rows.en: The cheerful spirit of the village fades as crops wither and livestock perish.
rows.ne: बाली ओइलाउँदै र पशुधन मर्दै जाँदा गाउँको हर्षोल्लास हराउँदै जान्छ।
rows.bt: As crops wither and livestock die, the village's joy fades away.

rows.en: But disaster strikes.
rows.ne: तर विपत्ति आइपर्छ।
rows.bt: But disaster strikes.

rows.bt: The village goes through a period when the fields yield no crops and water sources keep dwindling.
rows.note: The back-translation describes fallow rather than barren fields and does not explicitly retain the period of time.

rows.ne: तर विपत्ति आइपर्छ।

rows.bt: As crops wither and livestock die, the village's joy gradually disappears.

rows.en: Part 6:
rows.ne: भाग 6:
rows.bt: Part 6:

rows.en: Desperation grows among the villagers.
rows.ne: गाउँलेहरूमा हताशा बढ्दै जान्छ।
rows.bt: Despair keeps growing among the villagers.

rows.en: They’re convinced that if they could just play the Lost Rhythm in its entirety, the curse of scarcity would be lifted.
rows.ne: हराएको लय (Lost Rhythm) पूरै बजाउन सके मात्र पनि अभावको श्राप हट्नेछ भन्ने उनीहरूलाई पक्का विश्वास छ।
rows.bt: They firmly believe that if they can just play the Lost Rhythm in full, the curse of scarcity will be lifted.

rows.en: Part 7:
rows.ne: भाग 7:
rows.bt: Part 7:

rows.en: Yet, the elders, isolated in their ways and filled with pride, continue to play their partial melodies.
rows.ne: तैपनि, आफ्नै तौरतरिकामा सीमित रहेका र घमण्डले भरिएका ज्येष्ठजनहरू आआफ्ना अधुरा धुनहरू बजाइरहन्छन्।
rows.bt: Even so, the elders, confined to their own ways and filled with pride, keep playing their respective incomplete melodies.

rows.en: They are ignorant of the immense power the complete rhythm could yield, and so, the misfortune persists.
rows.ne: पूर्ण लयले उत्पन्न गर्न सक्ने अपार शक्तिबारे उनीहरू अनभिज्ञ छन्, त्यसैले दुर्भाग्य कायम रहन्छ।
rows.bt: They are unaware of the immense power that the complete rhythm can generate, so the misfortune continues.

rows.en: Part 8:
rows.ne: भाग 8:
rows.bt: Part 8:

rows.en: But not all hope is lost.
rows.ne: तर सबै आशा समाप्त भइसकेको छैन।
rows.bt: But not all hope has been lost.

rows.en: A young, spirited girl named Barjabeen, who has grown up amidst the rhythm and dance of the village, takes it upon herself to reunite the fragments of the Lost Rhythm.
rows.ne: गाउँको लय र नाचका बीच हुर्केकी Barjabeen नामकी उत्साही बालिकाले हराएको लयका टुक्राहरू फेरि जोड्ने जिम्मेवारी आफैँ लिन्छिन्।
rows.bt: An enthusiastic girl named Barjabeen, who grew up amidst the village's rhythm and dance, takes upon herself the responsibility of joining the pieces of the Lost Rhythm together again.

rows.en: Part 9:
rows.ne: भाग 9:
rows.bt: Part 9:

rows.en: Barjabeen’s journey is not without challenges.
rows.ne: Barjabeen को यात्रा चुनौतीरहित छैन।
rows.bt: Barjabeen's journey is not without challenges.

rows.en: With every hurdle, she gathers wisdom, her determination fortified by the dream of seeing her village thrive again.
rows.ne: हरेक बाधासँगै उनी थप बुद्धि-विवेक आर्जन गर्छिन्, र आफ्नो गाउँ फेरि फस्टाएको देख्ने सपनाले उनको सङ्कल्प अझ दृढ बनाउँछ।
rows.bt: With every obstacle, she gains more wisdom and discernment, and the dream of seeing her village flourish again makes her resolve even firmer.
rows.note: The source says she gathers wisdom, whereas the Nepali and back-translation describe gaining knowledge.

rows.en: Part 10:
rows.bt: Part 10:

rows.en: Harnessing the collective knowledge of the village and uniting the elders, Barjabeen endeavors to weave together the fragments, hoping to complete the Lost Rhythm and bring back prosperity to the village.
rows.ne: गाउँको सामूहिक ज्ञानको उपयोग गर्दै र ज्येष्ठजनहरूलाई एकजुट पार्दै, Barjabeen हराएको लय पूरा गर्ने र गाउँमा समृद्धि फर्काउने आशाका साथ त्यसका टुक्राहरू जोड्ने प्रयास गर्छिन्।
rows.bt: Using the village's collective knowledge and bringing the elders together, Barjabeen tries to join its pieces with the hope of completing the Lost Rhythm and bringing prosperity back to the village.
